item_name: Rothco MOLLE 2 QT. Bladder Canteen Cover
item_short_desc: Rothco’s MOLLE 2 QT. Bladder Canteen Cover is designed to keep you hydrated on-the-go. With its MOLLE compatibility, the cover seamlessly integrates with tactical vests, packs, or any gear featuring a MOLLE panel. The canteen cover comes with a detachable shoulder strap, offering versatility in carrying options—crossbody or over-the-shoulder. The MOLLE cover features a front pouch specifically for water purification tablets, ensuring clean drinking water wherever you are.
description: Rothco’s MOLLE 2 QT. Bladder Canteen Cover is designed to keep you hydrated on-the-go. With its MOLLE compatibility, the cover seamlessly integrates with tactical vests, packs, or any gear featuring a MOLLE panel. The canteen cover comes with a detachable shoulder strap, offering versatility in carrying options—crossbody or over-the-shoulder. The MOLLE cover features a front pouch specifically for water purification tablets, ensuring clean drinking water wherever you are. The secure buckle closure provides quick access to your canteen while ensuring reliable storage. Crafted from rugged and durable materials, this cover is built to withstand the rigors of outdoor adventures, promising years of reliable use. Perfect for military personnel, public safety workers, campers, backpackers, and anyone who enjoys the great outdoors. This canteen cover holds 2 quarts and measures 8 inches x 7 inches x 3 inches. Canteen not included.
